# Admin pages audit — Support, Marketing, Agency (Sitewave), Ads (Adloop)

## Cross-cutting finding: the three "Marketing" landing pages
Confirmed via `lib/admin-groups.ts` (the IA source of truth):
- The **Marketing** sidebar entry has tabs `Overview → /admin/marketing-hub`, `Discovery → /admin/marketing`, `Reviews → /admin/reviews` (lines 177–181).
- **`/admin/marketing-hub`** (the "Overview" tab) is essentially a **link farm that duplicates its own tab bar**: its `tools` array (marketing-hub/page.tsx:24–45) links to Discovery and Reviews — the exact two sibling tabs already shown in the sub-tab bar above it — plus Cold Email (a separate sidebar entry) and Tracking (an orphan). So the user sees "Discovery/Reviews" as tabs AND again as cards. Real overlap/confusion.
- **`/admin/marketing`** (Discovery) is the actual working feature (Marketing Agent queue + community drafts).
- **`/admin/marketing/studio`** is a *different* sidebar entry ("Studio": Studio/Assets/Calendar) — not overlapping in function, but it means "marketing" the concept is split across two sidebar entries plus a hub, which is the confusion the task flagged.

---

## `/admin/support/page.tsx` — Support desk
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Real ticket data, priority+closed sort (lines 39–46), live counts.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None.
- **UX gaps:** Empty state present (77–83). No loading/error state (server component, `force-dynamic` — acceptable). `take: 200` cap on tickets (line 28) with no pagination — silent truncation once >200 tickets; note the stat cards correctly use `groupBy`/`count` not the capped list, so only the *table* truncates.
- **Improvement:** **P3** — add "showing 200 of N" hint or pagination when the list is capped.

## `/admin/support/[id]/page.tsx` — Ticket detail
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Thread, staff reply, priority/status controls, customer-360 sidebar all wired to real controls (`TicketControls`).
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None. "Handling notes" (127–133) is static helper copy, appropriate.
- **UX gaps:** `notFound()` handles missing ticket (31). No visible pagination on messages (unbounded include, fine for tickets). Solid.
- **Improvement:** **P3** — none material.

## `/admin/chat/page.tsx` — Live chat inbox
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Counts correctly derived from table-wide `count()` not the capped `rows` (comment at 17–19 shows this was a deliberate fix). Typing indicator, staff-name resolution, client polling via `ChatInbox`.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None.
- **UX gaps:** `take: 200` on conversation list with no pagination (line 23) — same silent-truncation caveat, though stats are accurate. Depends on a live Anthropic key per memory (the agent side), but this inbox itself is just staff↔visitor and works without it.
- **Improvement:** **P3** — surface "200 shown" when capped.

## `/admin/feedback/page.tsx` — Feedback
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Kind/status filter pills (validated against enums, 59–60), triage controls, real data.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None.
- **UX gaps:** Empty state present (106–110). No cap on `findMany` (line 66) — unbounded query, minor scale risk but not a bug.
- **Improvement:** **P3** — add a `take` limit + pagination for scale.

## `/admin/marketing-hub/page.tsx` — Marketing > Overview
- **Coherent/current?** Partial. Works, but it's a redundant hub (see cross-cutting above).
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** Every count is wrapped in `.catch(() => 0)` (lines 17–21) — if a marketing table is missing/unmigrated the page silently shows **0** instead of erroring, which can mask a broken deploy. The **Tools grid is `sm:grid-cols-3` (line 59) but renders 4 tools** (Discovery/Reviews/Cold Email/Tracking, 24–45) → the 4th card wraps to a lonely second row. Layout bug.
- **UX gaps:** Duplicates the sub-tab bar's own Discovery/Reviews links; adds the only entry point to the orphaned Tracking page.
- **Improvement:**
  - **P2** — reconcile the hub with its tab bar: either drop the duplicated Discovery/Reviews cards, or repurpose the hub into a genuine dashboard. Fix `grid-cols-3`→`grid-cols-4` (or 2) so 4 cards lay out evenly.
  - **P3** — the `.catch(()=>0)` swallowing means a missing table reads as "0 signals"; consider distinguishing "0" from "unavailable".

## `/admin/marketing/page.tsx` — Discovery (Marketing Agent)
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Real queue + sources + stats + community drafts, all via `actions-marketing`/`actions-community`.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None. Honestly labeled "Dry run — this tool never posts anything itself" (sub, line 26).
- **UX gaps:** Empty/loading states are delegated to the client components (`MarketingQueueAdmin`, `CommunityDraftsAdmin`) — not visible here; assume handled there.
- **Improvement:** **P3** — page title is "Marketing Agent" while the tab is labeled "Discovery"; minor label drift.

## `/admin/marketing/studio/page.tsx` — Studio
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Thin server shell around `StudioEditor` (client). SVG→canvas PNG, browser-side. Real.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None.
- **UX gaps:** All interaction is in the client component; nothing to fault at page level.
- **Improvement:** none.

## `/admin/marketing/assets/page.tsx` — Assets
- **Coherent/current?** Yes. Real `marketingAsset` rows → `AssetGallery`.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** None. `take: 200` cap (line 12) uncounted/unpaginated but low risk.
- **UX gaps:** Empty state delegated to `AssetGallery` (header shows "0 saved creatives" gracefully via count).
- **Improvement:** **P3** — pagination if asset count grows past 200.

## `/admin/marketing/calendar/page.tsx` — Calendar / posting queue
- **Coherent/current?** Yes, with an honest scaffold boundary.
- **Dead/stale/redundant:** **Channel connectors are stubs** — comment lines 16–18 and header "Manual posting only — no auto-dispatch" (78). `ChannelsPanel` shows `connected`/`note` but nothing dispatches. This is disclosed scaffolding, not a bug.
- **UX gaps:** Posting is manual-only (mark-posted by hand). No auto-scheduling despite a "scheduled" status existing — expected for Phase 1.
- **Improvement:** **P2** — the "SCHEDULED" post status implies automation that doesn't exist; make sure the client UI makes clear a scheduled post still requires a human to post it (else operators may expect auto-dispatch).

## `/admin/marketing/tracking/page.tsx` — Tracking & Pixels (ORPHAN — confirmed)
- **Orphan confirmed:** Not present in any `tabs[]` in `lib/admin-groups.ts`. The **only** way to reach it is the marketing-hub Tools card (marketing-hub/page.tsx:41). No sidebar entry, no sub-tab, so `entryForPath` won't even highlight a parent — the sub-tab bar will show the *wrong* section or none when you land here.
- **Coherent/current?** Yes, and genuinely **valuable/real** — it persists Meta Pixel/CAPI + GA4 + Google Ads conversion labels via `getSetting`/`saveSettings` (lines 12–43), and the copy explains real site-wide firing. This is a working settings page, not a stub. It should NOT be deleted.
- **Value judgment:** Real and worth keeping — but it's hidden. An operator who needs to wire conversion tracking (directly tied to the Ads/Adloop product's whole premise) can't find it from the nav.
- **Improvement:**
  - **P1** — add Tracking to the IA. Natural home is the **Marketing** entry's tab bar (alongside Overview/Discovery/Reviews) or the **Ads/Adloop** entry (since Adloop's stated purpose is "optimize on real conversions").
